assets.binding_note: Corresponds only to Fig1 D28,d6,L41,P9 mm. The outer-shell cutaway is not a detachable component and cannot replace A/B or all lens geometries.

geometry_dispatch.A: embedded spectrum_A_cell parts; detach into distinct runtime sample entity
geometry_dispatch.B: source L13.49/P7.8 variant; can use L16 visual geometry reference but never inherit its physical ID
geometry_dispatch.L01-L40: custom_planar_waveguide corresponding lens_cell_k parts; detach before task starts

assets.interaction_gap: Current geometry is embedded in a display apparatus, not a generated/measured task entity. Independent grasp/collision/constraint and lineage-generation interfaces are needed. Missing shaft/blade/wall values retain their specimen_card status; template appearance does not make them source facts.

shared_identity_constraints: The standalone4958 and tube-embedded4958 visually represent the same task probe; do not accidentally instantiate two or four probes

Reusing the tube microphone as field_microphone requires tube withdrawal, identity transfer and field-station connection first; a separate numbered authored probe is possible but must not be claimed as reported by the paper

Hide/remove the tube's embedded A and waveguide's embedded 40 cells according to episode initial state, then generate entities through manufacturing events; a preassembled scene is not completed manufacture
GLB is Y-up and the fallback mesh is Z-up; explicitly transform and verify coordinates before scene use, without treating display axes as the paper's x/z
